runs.emptyBody: Once you export an agent to CI, every automated review shows up here.
runs.title: CI Runs
runs.subtitle: Agent reviews executed inside CI · not local runs

table.jobLabel: Open the CI job for {repo} on GitHub

runs.noMatch: No CI runs match these filters.

exportWizard.title: Export to CI
exportWizard.subtitle: Run {agentName} automatically on pull requests
exportWizard.repoHint: owner/name — the repo to add the workflow to
exportWizard.blockMergeDesc: Requires a GitHub App — not available with PAT in local mode
exportWizard.installCardTitle: Open a PR with these files
exportWizard.installCardBody: DevDigest opens a PR in {repo} titled “Add DevDigest CI review” with the {count} generated files.
exportWizard.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs.
exportWizard.noRepos: Connect a repository first — the workflow is added to one of your connected repos.
exportWizard.violationsTitle: This workflow breaks DevDigest's safety rules
exportWizard.editsDiscardedNote: You edited the workflow. Changing the triggers or the post mode regenerates it and discards those edits.
exportWizard.secretUnchecked: required — cannot be checked from DevDigest
exportWizard.failOnNote: set on the agent; change it in the CI tab.
exportWizard.requiredCheckNote: To block merging on findings, mark the DevDigest Review check as required in the repo's branch protection rules. A REQUEST_CHANGES review verdict alone does not block a merge: it only blocks under the repository's configured review rules, so the check must exit non-zero and be a required check.
exportWizard.forkNote: Pull requests from forks are skipped: the workflow never hands secrets to fork code. A skipped check can still satisfy a required check, so review fork PRs by hand.
exportWizard.zipCardBody: Get the {count} generated files as an archive and add them to the repo yourself. Nothing is sent to GitHub.
exportWizard.installBlocked: {count, plural, one {# workflow problem blocks} other {# workflow problems block}} the pull request. Fix {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} in the Preview step, or download the .zip instead.
exportWizard.installedBody: A pull request is ready in {repo}. Merge it, then add the secret to start reviewing.
exportWizard.zipDoneBody: The .zip was downloaded. Add its files to the repo, then add the secret.

errors.generic: Something went wrong while talking to the DevDigest engine.
errors.no_repository: This repository is not connected to the workspace any more.
errors.repo_not_accessible: GitHub can't see this repository with your token. Check that the token covers it.
errors.token_missing: No GitHub token is configured. Add one in Settings, then try again.
errors.token_permission_missing: The GitHub token lacks permission. It needs Contents, Pull requests and Workflows write access. You can download the .zip instead.
errors.agent_not_exportable: Only agents that use the OpenRouter provider can be exported to CI.
errors.runner_bundle_missing: The CI runner bundle isn't built. Run “cd agent-runner && pnpm install && pnpm build”, then try again.
errors.workflow_invalid: The workflow didn't pass validation. Fix the problems listed in the Preview step.
errors.github_unavailable: GitHub didn't respond. Try again in a moment, or download the .zip.

ciTab.heading: Continuous Integration
ciTab.subtitle: Run this agent automatically on pull requests in a target repo.
ciTab.empty: Not deployed to CI yet. Use “Add to CI” to open a PR that adds the workflow and agent config.
ciTab.activeIn: {count, plural, =0 {Not active in any repo} one {Active in # repo} other {Active in # repos}}
ciTab.outdatedNotice: This agent changed after it was exported. The change reaches CI after you export again (Add to CI) and merge the PR.
ciTab.historyEmpty: No CI runs for this agent yet.

publishDialog.title: Publish to CI
publishDialog.subtitle: Run {agentName} on every pull request in {repo}
publishDialog.intro: Opens a pull request in {repo} adding a GitHub Actions workflow + this agent's config under .devdigest/. On every PR the agent reviews the diff.
publishDialog.secretNote: Add {key} to the repo's Actions secrets before the workflow runs. GITHUB_TOKEN is provided automatically.
publishDialog.doneBody: Opened/updated a pull request in {repo} with the workflow + agent config.
